About the job

Position Title: TikTok Shop Affiliate Specialist

Department: Marketing & Creator Operations

Reports To: Director of Content and Community

Location: Remote — US & LATAM

Job Type: Full-Time




Company Overview

Our client a fast-growing US-Based pet brand selling innovative tools that have quickly become essentials in millions of homes.

Their products reach customers through their direct-to-consumer store and major retailers. Creator-led commerce—especially on TikTok Shop—is one of their fastest-growing acquisition channels.




Position Summary

We are seeking an organized, proactive, and creator-obsessed TikTok Shop Affiliate Specialist to support the daily operations and scaling of our creator program.

In this hands-on role, your primary mission is to ensure our affiliate pipeline never stalls. You will drive daily outreach, manage creator sample fulfillment, coordinate automated communications, moderate our creator community, and analyze short-form content patterns that generate revenue. Working directly with our Director of Content and Community, you will turn high-level campaign plans into consistent operational action that directly impacts month-over-month affiliate GMV.




Key Responsibilities

1. TikTok Shop & Affiliate Operations

Support the day-to-day execution and operational health of the client's TikTok Shop affiliate program.

Review incoming sample requests, evaluating creators based on audience fit, content quality, and sales potential.
Coordinate time-sensitive sample fulfillment workflows directly with our warehouse logistics team.
Monitor TikTok Shop account health, handle documentation, manage support tickets, and resolve operational roadblocks quickly.
Track program risks, performance gaps, and activation metrics, reporting insights directly to the Affiliate Marketing Manager.

2. Campaign Execution & Content Analysis

Help execute affiliate campaigns, creator contests, seasonal challenges, and performance incentives.
Clear campaign details, deadlines, and deliverables to creators; track participation and follow up to drive posting volume.

Utilize AI and automation tools to streamline recurring reminders, updates, and creator follow-ups.

4. Ambassador, UGC & Social Strategy Support

Required Qualifications & Experience

Experience: Minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience managing or supporting a TikTok Shop affiliate program for a CPG/consumer brand (outside of the fashion category).
Platform Knowledge: Proficiency with TikTok Shop Affiliate Center, short-form social platforms, and creator management software. Direct experience with Cruva, Upfluence, Discord, and Later is strongly preferred.
Content Literacy: Strong instincts for short-form video mechanics—you know what makes a compelling hook, a smooth product demo, and a converting call-to-action.
Technical Skills: Experience utilizing AI tools and workflows to automate repetitive creator communication and task management. Basic short-form video editing skills.
Soft Skills: Exceptional organizational skills, high attention to detail, proactive problem-solving, and strong written communication skills tailored for creator relationships.




Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Creator Participation: Increase in creator posting volume and participation rate in active campaigns.

Revenue Impact: Measurable contribution to overall month-over-month TikTok Shop affiliate GMV growth.




What We Offer

description:
About the job

Rockstar is recruiting for a marketplace management firm that handles e-commerce operations for brands across major retail channels. They specialize in catalog management, content, retail operations, and advertising on platforms like Amazon, Walmart, and Target Plus. Their AI Agentic Commerce practice builds proprietary tooling for optimized performance.


About the Company



The company manages the marketplace business for brands that can't afford to get it wrong. They handle catalog, content, retail operations, and advertising across Amazon (Seller Central and Vendor Central), Walmart Marketplace, Target Plus, and other emerging channels, and they run an AI Agentic Commerce practice building their own tooling for this work.

Their clients span consumer packaged goods, cosmetics, skincare, apparel, footwear, and handbags. They hire them to operate their channel, not to advise from a distance.


The Role



Advertising Analysts run the accounts. This is the seat where the work actually happens.

Analysts own the day-to-day management of advertising for a set of client brands across Amazon, Walmart Marketplace, and Target Plus — building campaigns, managing bids and budgets, adjusting targeting, watching pacing, and finding the changes that move performance. Their manager sets the strategy and the media plan; they make it real in the platform, and they are the first person to know when something isn't working.

This is an individual contributor role, but it isn't a heads-down one. Analysts work directly with the Strategy & Implementation Team on retail readiness — inventory, catalog, promotions, detail page quality — and with the Design Team on creative for Sponsored Brands, video, and display. Advertising in these channels doesn't perform in isolation, and analysts who understand that make better recommendations than analysts who only look at ad reports.

Analysts also do a meaningful amount of thinking, not just executing. They run account audits, dig into search term and placement data to find waste and opportunity, build the analysis behind quarterly and annual business reviews, and prepare the decks their manager presents to client leadership. Where they see a better answer than the plan calls for, the company wants to hear it.

The company expects analysts to use AI in their work. The team uses AI for report analysis, bulk file preparation, keyword and search term work, audit drafting, and internal tooling. They don't need to be an engineer, but they should be comfortable working with AI tools and interested in using them to get through the mechanical parts of the job faster so they can spend more time on the parts that require judgment.

This role is a path to account and strategy ownership. The analysts who do it well are the people the company promotes.


What You'll Own


Campaign management and optimization: Build, launch, and manage Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Brands Video, Sponsored Display, and Amazon DSP campaigns, plus their Walmart Connect and Target Roundel equivalents. Manage bids, budgets, negatives, placement modifiers, and dayparting against agreed targets. Keep pacing on plan and flag risk before it becomes a shortfall.
Keyword, targeting, and audience work: Research and build keyword and product targeting sets, mine search term reports for new opportunity and wasted spend, and maintain clean negative structures. Support audience building and testing in DSP.
Analysis: Pull and interrogate the data yourself — search term, placement, product-level, and business reports — and turn it into a recommendation rather than a summary. Understand why a number moved, not just that it did.
Account audits: Perform structured audits on new and existing accounts: campaign architecture, targeting overlap, budget allocation, wasted spend, missed placements, and gaps between what the account is doing and what the strategy calls for. Write up findings clearly enough that someone else can act on them.
Client reporting and business reviews: Build the reporting that keeps clients informed, and prepare the analysis and decks for quarterly and annual business reviews. Your work goes in front of client leadership, so it needs to be accurate, clear, and defensible.
AI-assisted workflows: Use AI tools to speed up analysis, bulk file work, keyword processing, and documentation. Contribute to improving how the team works rather than just following the process you were handed.
Collaboration: Partner with the Strategy & Implementation Team on retail readiness and the Design Team on creative. Raise the constraints — inventory, catalog, pricing, page quality — that advertising can't fix on its own.

What You Bring



Required

2+ years hands-on experience building, managing, and optimizing Amazon advertising campaigns
Amazon Ads certification in Sponsored Ads and Amazon DSP (both required; verified)
Experience with Amazon DSP campaign management, not just Sponsored Ads
Genuinely analytical: comfortable in large data sets, can build your own analysis in Excel or Sheets, and check your own math
Intellectual curiosity: want to know why something happened, and keep pulling the thread after the immediate question is answered
Strong written and verbal communication: can explain a performance change in plain language and write findings a client can read
Proficiency working with AI tools and AI-assisted workflows
Detail discipline: bulk uploads, naming conventions, and negatives done right the first time


Preferred

Walmart Sponsored Ads and Walmart DSP certification
Meta and TikTok ads experience, with certifications
Target Roundel experience
SQL, Looker Studio / Google Data Studio, or Amazon Marketing Cloud exposure
Agency or multi-brand experience across categories
Advanced Excel; Python or scripting a plus
Familiarity with retail fundamentals: Buy Box, inventory health, catalog integrity, promotions, subscriptions

Who Does Well Here



The work is cyclical and the peaks are demanding — Q4 and Prime Day compress a quarter of decisions into a few weeks. The analysts who do well here treat a bad week as something to diagnose rather than defend, and would rather find the problem themselves than be told about it.

The company also looks for ownership (escalate early and don't lose things), intellectual honesty (would rather be corrected than confidently wrong), care about accuracy, and a habit of fixing a manual process the third time you run it.


What Success Looks Like


30 days: Managing daily optimizations on your accounts with light supervision, and you know each brand's structure, targets, and constraints.
90 days: Running your accounts independently, delivering audits and reporting your manager doesn't have to rewrite, and surfacing recommendations rather than waiting for direction.
12 months: Your accounts show measurable improvement you can explain, you're trusted in front of clients, and you've improved at least one thing about how the team works.

How to Stand Out



Come ready to walk through one account you improved — what you found, what you changed, and how you knew it worked.

About the job

Sobre Covalto

En Covalto estamos reinventando los servicios financieros para las PyMEs en Latinoamérica y más allá. A través de nuestras soluciones especializadas de intermediación financiera, ayudamos a las empresas a crecer, proporcionándoles el capital y las herramientas financieras que necesitan para desarrollarse y competir con éxito en el mercado norteamericano.

No buscamos simplemente empleados; buscamos Cóvalticos: personas innovadoras, disruptivas y con espíritu constructor, que se desenvuelvan con éxito en entornos Fintech dinámicos y de ritmo acelerado.




Tu misión

Como Growth & Sales Account Executive, tu misión será contribuir a la continuidad operativa y al crecimiento exponencial de Covalto.

Serás responsable de gestionar el ciclo completo de ventas de nuestras soluciones de intermediación financiera, enfocándote exclusivamente en PyMEs con operaciones en Norteamérica. Además, participarás activamente en el diseño y automatización de procesos para construir un motor comercial escalable, eficiente y preparado para el crecimiento futuro.




¿Qué harás? — Principales responsabilidades

Ser responsable del pipeline de ventas en EE. UU.

Gestionar de principio a fin el ciclo comercial de manera remota, desde la prospección y presentación de la solución hasta la negociación y cierre de operaciones de financiamiento con propietarios de empresas ubicadas en Norteamérica.

Diseñar y automatizar procesos

Colaborar en el diseño, implementación y automatización de sistemas y flujos de trabajo comerciales, incluyendo CRM, lead scoring, herramientas de prospección y outreach, con el objetivo de escalar las operaciones.

Entender las necesidades financieras de las PyMEs

Comprender las necesidades financieras de las PyMEs norteamericanas y posicionar las soluciones de intermediación financiera de Covalto como una herramienta estratégica para impulsar su crecimiento.

Colaboración entre áreas

Trabajar de manera cercana con los equipos de Riesgo, Producto y Operaciones para optimizar la experiencia del cliente durante todo el proceso, desde el onboarding hasta la obtención del financiamiento.




¿Qué buscamos?

Inglés avanzado — Requisito indispensable

Dominas el inglés de manera oral y escrita y tienes capacidad para negociar en inglés a nivel nativo o C1/C2. Comprendes el lenguaje corporativo estadounidense, sus expresiones habituales y las normas de etiqueta empresarial.

Conocimiento de la cultura empresarial norteamericana

Tienes un conocimiento profundo de la cultura de negocios de Norteamérica y comprendes cómo piensan, toman decisiones y hacen negocios los propietarios de PyMEs estadounidenses.

Experiencia en Fintech o Ventas

About the job

At AIG, we are reimagining the way we help customers to manage risk. Join us as an Integrated Marketing Specialist to play your part in that transformation. It’s an opportunity to grow your skills and experience as a valued member of the team.

Make Your Mark In Global Functions

Global Functions provide a wide range of services to the organization such as Business IT and Operations, Finance, Marketing & Communications, Security and Human Resources. Its teams play a vital role in ensuring we deliver for our customers and achieve our business goals.

The Integrated Marketing Specialist will support AIG Mexico and the Miami Facultative Desk by executing integrated marketing initiatives across digital channels and broker engagement activities. The role reports to the FAC Desk Marketing Lead with a dotted line to the Mexico Marketing Lead and works closely with commercial leaders across the region.

How you will create an impact



Execute digital and content marketing campaigns, social media, website updates, email communications and editorial calendars. 
Create engaging content, presentations and short-form videos aligned with AIG brand standards. 
Coordinate broker and client events in Mexico and regional Facultative markets, including logistics, vendors, budgets and post-event reporting. 
Partner with Distribution and business leaders to develop content marketing initiatives that support commercial priorities. 
Manage external agencies and suppliers, ensuring quality, consistency and on-time delivery. 
Track campaign and event performance, providing insights and recommendations for continuous improvement. 
Support broader Marketing & Communications initiatives as business priorities evolve. 


What You’ll Need To Succeed



Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Advertising or related field. 
3-5 years of experience in B2B marketing with a strong focus on digital marketing and event management. 
Experience managing agencies, multiple stakeholders and simultaneous projects. 
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Spanish. 
Advanced English language proficiency (participates in meetings with other countries), including speaking, reading, and writing. Fluency in English is required.
Strong organizational skills, creativity, commercial mindset and attention to detail. 
Knowledge of LinkedIn, Meta Business Suite, Canva, Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel. Experience with CRM platforms is desirable but not required. 


Success in the First 12 Months 



Deliver high-quality marketing support to Mexico and the Miami FAC Desk. 
Execute integrated campaigns aligned with business priorities. 
Coordinate successful broker and client events with measurable business impact. 
Become a trusted marketing partner for commercial stakeholders across both businesses. 


Ready to take your career to the next level? We would love to hear from you.

At AIG, we value in-person collaboration as a vital part of our culture, which is why we ask our team members to be primarily in the office. This approach helps us work together effectively and create a supportive, connected environment for our team and clients alike.

Enjoy Benefits That Take Care Of What Matters

At AIG, our people are our greatest asset. We know how important it is to protect and invest in what’s most important to you. That is why we created our Total Rewards Program, a comprehensive benefits package that extends beyond time spent at work to offer benefits focused on your health, wellbeing and financial security—as well as your professional development—to bring peace of mind to you and your family.

Reimagining insurance to make a bigger difference to the world

American International Group, Inc. (AIG) is a global leader in commercial and personal insurance solutions; we are one of the world’s most far-reaching property casualty networks. It is an exciting time to join us — across our operations, we are thinking in new and innovative ways to deliver ever-better solutions to our customers. At AIG, you can go further to support individuals, businesses, and communities, helping them to manage risk, respond to times of uncertainty and discover new potential. We invest in our largest asset, our people, through continuous learning and development, in a culture that celebrates everyone for who they are and what they want to become.

Welcome to a culture of inclusion

We’re committed to creating a culture that truly respects and celebrates each other’s talents, backgrounds, cultures, opinions and goals. We foster a culture of inclusion and belonging through learning, cultural awareness activities and Employee Resource Groups (ERGs). With global chapters, ERGs are a cornerstone for our culture of inclusion. The talent of our people is one of AIG’s greatest assets, and we are honored that our drive for positive change has been recognized by numerous recent awards and accreditations.

We’ve helped brands launch, scale, and reach millions in GMV on TikTok Shop, and we believe the future of e-commerce is social. Our team is built around high-agency operators who take ownership, move fast, and grow into leaders.

This is not a support role for the sake of support. It’s a training ground for future operators and Account Managers.

Role Overview

This role is the execution and operations backbone for TikTok Shop accounts.

You’ll work directly under an Account Manager, helping translate strategy into action, maintain shop health, coordinate cross-functional work, and ensure flawless execution across multiple client accounts.

What You’ll Do

TikTok Shop Operations


Register campaigns, flash sales, and backend promotions
Execute day-to-day TikTok Shop backend operations, including:
Campaign setup and monitoring
Product and shop management
In-system sampling workflows
Content tracking and GMV delivery
Coordinate sample orders and product logistics
Support CRM campaign setup 
Monitor shop health, inventory status, listings, and campaign readiness
Proactively flag operational risks or issues

Creator & Affiliate Operations


Manage creator and affiliate communication and coordination
Draft and maintain creator content guidelines and briefing documents
Track sample requests, deliveries, posting status, and creator compliance
Support affiliate and paid collaboration programs from sourcing through posting
Oversee and guide VA execution related to creator communication, sampling, and data entry


Content & Ads Execution Support


Identify strong-performing TikTok Shop content and surface top creatives
Support creative rotation by flagging ads for testing or boosting
Maintain content and performance documentation for cross-functional teams


Performance Tracking & Reporting


Track and analyze key metrics including GMV, traffic, conversion rate, CTR, CTOR, and content volume
Conduct funnel analysis and surface insights to improve performance
Maintain accurate trackers, reports, and internal documentation
Support weekly and monthly reporting for internal teams and brand partners


Cross-Functional Coordination


Work closely with Ads, Creative, Operations, and external partners
Support assortment launches, promotions, pricing updates, and campaign registrations
Ensure alignment and smooth execution across all initiatives


Ideal Candidate Profile

You’ll Be a Strong Fit If You Are


Full professional fluency in English. C1 or above
Detail-oriented, organized, and execution-focused
Comfortable juggling multiple campaigns, brands, and timelines
Curious about social commerce, marketplaces, and creator-driven growth
Proactive, resourceful, and able to take ownership of tasks end-to-end
Coachable and eager to learn through hands-on execution


Qualifications


1–3+ years of experience in social commerce, affiliate marketing, influencer marketing, ecommerce operations, or digital marketing
Hands-on experience with TikTok Shop strongly preferred
Experience with Amazon, Shopify, DTC, or other marketplaces is a plus
Strong analytical skills; comfortable working with spreadsheets and dashboards
Understanding of creator workflows, affiliate mechanics, and content-driven commerce
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
Ability to operate in a fast-paced, evolving environment with minimal oversight
Growth mindset with interest in expanding scope over time


Why Join Spotlight Media


Work at the cutting edge of social commerce and TikTok Shop
Real ownership and responsibility from day one
Exposure to high-growth brands and creator ecosystems
Collaborative, high-performance team culture

Buscamos a alguien que no solo ejecute campañas, sino que entienda los datos, identifique oportunidades y convierta la estrategia digital en resultados para el negocio.




Si te interesa asumir este reto y formar parte de una empresa sólida y en constante evolución, postúlate y comparte con nosotros tu experiencia.

title: Marketing and Lead Generation Manager
description:
About the job

Marketing & Lead Generation Manager




About the Role




Peterson Spring is looking for a results-driven Marketing & Lead Generation Manager to build and execute a modern B2B marketing strategy focused on generating qualified sales opportunities and supporting new business growth.




This position will work closely with the sales and business development teams to identify target customers, build awareness of Peterson Spring’s capabilities, generate qualified leads, and turn marketing activity into measurable sales opportunities.




The ideal candidate is not simply a social media manager. We are looking for someone who understands B2B manufacturing marketing, digital lead generation, content creation, targeted account marketing, and sales enablement and can take ownership of the process from strategy through execution.




Key Responsibilities




Lead Generation & Demand Generation




- Develop and execute strategies to generate qualified B2B sales leads.

- Build targeted prospect lists based on Peterson Spring’s ideal customer profile and target industries.

- Develop campaigns targeting specific companies, industries, and decision-makers.

- Utilize LinkedIn, email marketing, digital advertising, SEO, content marketing, and other channels to generate new opportunities.

- Develop and manage lead-generation campaigns in coordination with the sales team.

- Track leads from initial engagement through qualification and handoff to sales.

- Continuously test and improve campaigns based on performance.




Targeted Account Marketing




- Develop targeted marketing campaigns for high-value prospective customers.

- Research target companies, industries, products, and decision-makers.

- Create personalized marketing content and campaigns designed to get Peterson Spring in front of purchasing, engineering, supply chain, and other key decision-makers.

- Support account-based marketing initiatives for strategic prospects.

- Work directly with Business Development to identify priority accounts and create campaigns around them.




Content & Social Media




- Manage Peterson Spring’s LinkedIn and other relevant social media platforms.

- Create professional, engaging content that showcases Peterson Spring’s manufacturing capabilities, facilities, equipment, quality systems, products, and employees.

- Develop content that positions Peterson Spring as a capable supplier to Automotive, Aerospace & Defense, Industrial, and other target markets.

- Create case studies, customer success stories, brochures, sales presentations, email campaigns, and other sales-support materials.

- Coordinate photography, video, graphics, and other marketing assets.

- Maintain a consistent and professional brand presence across all channels.




Website & Digital Marketing




- Manage and continuously improve website content with a focus on generating sales inquiries.

- Develop landing pages and digital campaigns for targeted industries and products.

- Improve SEO and organic search visibility.

- Monitor website traffic, engagement, conversions, and lead sources.

- Identify opportunities to improve Peterson Spring's digital presence and online visibility.




Sales Support




- Work closely with Business Development and Account Managers to support active sales campaigns.

- Provide sales teams with prospect information, marketing materials, target-account research, and campaign results.

- Help develop presentations, brochures, capability documents, email campaigns, and other sales tools.

- Maintain visibility into marketing-generated leads and opportunities.

- Help establish a measurable connection between marketing activity and revenue.




Analytics & Reporting




- Establish measurable KPIs for marketing and lead-generation activities.

- Track leads, website traffic, campaign performance, engagement, conversion rates, and marketing-generated opportunities.

- Provide regular reporting to leadership.

- Identify what is working, what isn't, and make recommendations for improvement.

- Manage marketing budgets and maximize return on marketing spend.




Required Qualifications




- 3–7 years of marketing experience, preferably in B2B, manufacturing, industrial, automotive, aerospace, defense, or another technical industry.

- Demonstrated experience generating B2B leads and sales opportunities.

- Strong understanding of LinkedIn marketing and B2B social media.

- Experience with targeted account marketing / account-based marketing (ABM).

- Experience developing and executing digital marketing campaigns.

- Strong content creation and copywriting skills.

- Experience with email marketing and lead-nurturing campaigns.

- Understanding of SEO, website analytics, and digital advertising.

- Strong research skills and the ability to identify target companies and decision-makers.

- Experience working with a CRM and marketing automation platform.

- Strong communication and project-management skills.

- Ability to work independently and take ownership of projects from strategy through execution.

- Strong analytical mindset with the ability to use data to improve marketing performance.




Preferred Qualifications




- Experience marketing for a manufacturing or industrial company.

- Experience marketing to OEMs, Tier 1s, Tier 2s, distributors, or other B2B customers.

- Experience with HubSpot or similar CRM/marketing automation platforms.

- Experience with LinkedIn Campaign Manager and LinkedIn advertising.

- Experience with Google Analytics, Google Ads, SEO tools, or similar platforms.

- Experience creating marketing materials using Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar tools.

- Experience developing ABM campaigns.

- Familiarity with the Automotive or Aerospace & Defense industries.

- Experience supporting trade shows and industry events.

- Bilingual English/Spanish is a plus.




What Success Looks Like




The successful candidate will be measured by business results, not simply social media activity.




Key measures of success will include:




- Number of qualified leads generated.

- Number of sales opportunities generated.

- Marketing-generated revenue.

- Target accounts engaged.

- Website lead conversions.

- Email campaign performance.

- LinkedIn engagement and prospect growth.

- Growth in Peterson Spring's digital presence.

- Cost per qualified lead.

- Return on marketing investment.

- Sales team's utilization of marketing-generated leads and materials.




Ideal Candidate




We are looking for someone who is:




- Results-driven

- Highly organized and self-motivated

- Comfortable working independently

- Creative but also analytical

- Strong at researching and identifying opportunities

- Comfortable working directly with sales leadership

- Able to turn ideas into executed campaigns

- Comfortable working in a technical B2B environment

- Focused on generating measurable business results rather than vanity metrics




This is an opportunity for someone who wants to build a marketing and lead-generation function, not simply maintain an existing marketing program.




The ideal candidate will have the creativity to build the strategy, the technical knowledge to execute it, and the business mindset to connect marketing activity directly to new customer growth and revenue.

description:
About the job

Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day. 

We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers. 

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. 

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact. 

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

The Merchant Care Analyst I is the foundational tier within our Merchant Care organisation, responsible for delivering efficient and timely responses to merchant inquiries. You will support tickets raised by merchants through any channel, instant messaging, email or web form, as well as requests from internal stakeholders, ensuring queries are addressed promptly and accurately within a specific product scope. The role combines resolving documented issues independently using our established knowledge base with recognising cases of higher complexity and escalating them with clear context to an Analyst II or Senior Analyst. Success in this role means strong communication, a solid understanding of payments, and a genuine sense of urgency in everything you pick up.

What You Will Be Doing


Acknowledge and administer tickets assigned via the ticketing system, remaining logged in and active during working hours.
Investigate and respond to merchant inquiries, as well as requests from internal stakeholders who engage Merchant Care for technical assistance.
Perform initial investigations and refer complex concerns to Analyst II, Senior Analysts, or Level 3 teams as appropriate, providing full context for a speedy resolution.

description:
About the job

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

The Global Payments Performance Team identifies payment optimization opportunities for Stripe’s merchants. The Global Payments Performance team serves a critical role both in demonstrating thought leadership on challenging payment topics, and also partnering with our high-potential merchants to set them up for long term success. We want a partnership with Stripe to be a competitive advantage for our customers, large and small, by providing them with best-in-class technology in concert with insightful and specific advice on how to harness this technology to achieve their business goals.

What you’ll do

The Payments Performance Strategist, LatAm, will be responsible for leading data-driven discussions with existing and prospective LatAm merchants on optimisation strategies across a variety of areas including, card network costs, acceptance, fraud, and cross-border flows to start. Initially, the focus will be primarily on the Mexican market. You will be instrumental in building our optimisation narratives/tools and delivering on our merchant engagement model. You will also collaborate with Sales, deploying your knowledge to differentiate Stripe to win deals, and partner with our Customer Success organization to ensure that merchants are successful working with Stripe.

Responsibilities


Lead discussions with existing and prospective LatAm merchants, and provide the Sales team with tools and training to lead discussions with merchants and prospects.
Serve as both an internal and merchant-facing expert on payment optimisation strategies in LatAm.
Gather and build on Stripe’s wide-ranging payments expertise to create LatAm optimisation narratives/tools supported by rigorous analysis.
Use existing tools to deploy sophisticated optimisation playbooks and analyses across Stripe’s LatAm customer portfolio.
Synthesise and relay customer feedback and our findings to inform Stripe’s product roadmap.
Provide feedback on our tools and playbooks to help continuously improve our self serve offerings



Who you are

Minimum Requirements


7+ years of experience in payments or operations at a leading technology company, or consultancy in the payments industry, with a focus on the LatAm market
Understanding of e-commerce payments, cards based payments processing and optimisation strategies
A proven ability to build collaborative working relationships with cross-functional teams.
The ability to deal effectively with ambiguity and thrive in an unstructured, fast-moving environment.
A proven ability to be a self-starter capable of driving business results without significant supervision.
Experience presenting directly to merchants
Serve as a subject matter expert providing both internal and customer-facing advisory in the payments domain.
Develop optimization playbooks and stay updated on industry best practices and Stripe innovations
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Strong data processing, organizational and analytical skills.
Language proficiency in Spanish



Preferred Requirements


Experience with SQL, dashboard building, modeling, or reporting
Understanding of card network rules and regulations, local payment methods, and the regulatory environment (PSD2/PSD3)
Experience presenting to senior business leaders



In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

Owner analítico del funnel completo: NQL→SQL→Enrolamiento→Aprobación→Activación→Retención. Diagnosticar dónde se pierde valor, cuantificar el tamaño de cada oportunidad y mantener un Control Tower con CAC, payback, LTV y Gross Profit por canal, levantando alertas cuando algo se desvía de la tesis

Resolución de problemas estratégicos (tu día a día estilo consultoría): estructurar problemas ambiguos en análisis accionables — descomponer una caída de ventas en tasa × ticket × volumen, diagnosticar un funnel SDR, dimensionar un canal nuevo con un business case
Pricing & elegibilidad (con Riesgo): modelar bandas de precio/score-cut y diseñar/leer experimentos A/B que equilibren aprobación y margen
Research de cliente: entrevistas, jobs-to-be-done e insights de mercado que se traducen en ofertas, mensajes y apuestas de segmento

De la recomendación a la ejecución: bajar la estrategia a instrumentos operables — playbooks de Outbound, lead scoring, territories, listas activables (AI/enrichment), briefs de Digital — y coordinar handoffs con SDR/AE, Marketing y Growth
Cadencia operativa: preparar y facilitar WBR/MBR. No reportas métricas: cuentas la historia del negocio, propones la decisión y das seguimiento a los compromisos

Experimentación y gobierno de datos: priorizar hipótesis, diseñar tests, instrumentar tracking, productizar ganadores (playbook + métricas); definir eventos, taxonomías y QA de tracking con Analytics/Eng

Xepelin está transformando las finanzas empresariales en Latinoamérica con una suite de productos que automatizan la gestión financiera y facilitan el acceso a liquidez. Con el objetivo de convertirse en el CFO digital de todo negocio, ha desarrollado tecnología financiera que impacta en todo el ecosistema empresarial. Gracias a la data obtenida por la interacción de +1M de empresas dentro de su network, se construye un sistema de inteligencia de negocios que da visibilidad de indicadores financieros y evaluaciones de riesgo de la red con la que se colabora, ayudando a que la toma de decisiones sea más rápida y segura.

Nuestros principios ¿Cómo operamos?
🎯 Ponemos a nuestros clientes en el centro

✨ Creemos e inspiramos

🧑‍💼 Actuamos como dueños

🏅 Lideramos con el ejemplo

🏆 Nos desafiamos para ganar

🧠 Tomamos riesgos con inteligencia

🤖 Usamos el poder de la tecnología

¿Qué estamos buscando?
En Xepelin estamos buscando personas creativas y visionarias que piensen fuera de la caja para sumarse a nuestro equipo. Si te apasiona resolver desafíos interesantes de alto impacto y quieres ser parte de un entorno dinámico que está transformando la industria financiera, ¡Esta oportunidad es para ti!

Si te motiva el desafío de construir soluciones innovadoras en un entorno de rápido cambio, queremos conocerte.

Únete a nosotros, ¡crezcamos juntos!

Misión del rol
Ser el cerebro analítico detrás de la estrategia de crecimiento de Xepelin México: definir dónde, cómo y a qué costo adquirimos clientes y convertir ese análisis en decisiones que el negocio ejecuta. El problema central es de los buenos: ¿dónde está el siguiente peso de crecimiento rentable? ¿Más Outbound, mejor pricing, otro segmento, un canal nuevo? Es un problema de asignación de capital, y tú eres quien lo modela, lo recomienda y lo acompaña hasta el resultado.

Principales responsabilidades


Estrategia de crecimiento y asignación de recursos: definir, junto al liderazgo del negocio, la estrategia de adquisición de la compañía — qué canales (Outbound, Inbound, Brokers, Digital), qué segmentos (SMB/Mid/Corp) y qué economics justifican cada inversión
Owner analítico del funnel completo: NQL→SQL→Enrolamiento→Aprobación→Activación→Retención. Diagnosticar dónde se pierde valor, cuantificar el tamaño de cada oportunidad y mantener un Control Tower con CAC, payback, LTV y Gross Profit por canal, levantando alertas cuando algo se desvía de la tesis
Resolución de problemas estratégicos (tu día a día estilo consultoría): estructurar problemas ambiguos en análisis accionables — descomponer una caída de ventas en tasa × ticket × volumen, diagnosticar un funnel SDR, dimensionar un canal nuevo con un business case
Pricing & elegibilidad (con Riesgo): modelar bandas de precio/score-cut y diseñar/leer experimentos A/B que equilibren aprobación y margen
Research de cliente: entrevistas, jobs-to-be-done e insights de mercado que se traducen en ofertas, mensajes y apuestas de segmento
De la recomendación a la ejecución: bajar la estrategia a instrumentos operables — playbooks de Outbound, lead scoring, territories, listas activables (AI/enrichment), briefs de Digital — y coordinar handoffs con SDR/AE, Marketing y Growth
Cadencia operativa: preparar y facilitar WBR/MBR. No reportas métricas: cuentas la historia del negocio, propones la decisión y das seguimiento a los compromisos
Experimentación y gobierno de datos: priorizar hipótesis, diseñar tests, instrumentar tracking, productizar ganadores (playbook + métricas); definir eventos, taxonomías y QA de tracking con Analytics/Eng





¿Qué necesitas para brillar?


Pensamiento estructurado: descompones problemas ambiguos en árboles de hipótesis, priorizas el análisis que mueve la decisión y comunicas con claridad ejecutiva (escrita y verbal)
Estratega operador(a): la recomendación no te basta; bajas la idea a dashboard, playbook y piloto en días, no semanas
Data chops: SQL intermedio-avanzado, manejo de BigQuery/Looker o equivalentes; familiaridad con causalidad/experimentos y métricas de funnel
AI driven: experto en Claude/Chat GPT/Gemini/otros, con casos de uso claros y con impacto
Track record de impacto en KPIs: has movido números concretos — enrolamientos, aprobación, activación, churn — y puedes contar el cómo, no solo el cuánto
Obsesión por el cliente: research continuo, entrevistas, jobs-to-be-done, y capacidad de transformar insights en ofertas y mensajes accionables
Influencia cross-functional: te mueves con Revenue, Growth, Riesgo, Producto y Finanzas con la misma comodidad, sin autoridad formal
Owner mindset: foco en impacto económico (CAC, payback, margen, LTV), no en entregables





Requisitos


2+ años en consultoría estratégica o roles GTM/Strategy/Growth/RevOps analíticos, ideal con foco en adquisición B2B (fintech, SaaS, pagos o lending es plus)
Experiencia probada gestionando funnel completo y mejorando KPIs (enrolamientos, aprobación, activación, churn)
SQL (intermedio a avanzado) y Excel/Sheets avanzado
La posición es para CDMX. Si actualmente estás en Chile pero tienes disponibilidad para mudarte a Ciudad de México, esta oportunidad puede ser para ti. 





Nuestros Beneficios:

🌴 Xepelin Balance

Vacaciones: 15 días hábiles. Por cada año que cumplas en Xepelin, te damos un día extra de vacaciones.

Balance days: 10 días libres adicionales al año, para disfrutar como quieras.

Beneficios Flexibles: Puntos flexibles en tu moneda local al mes para gastar en lo que quieras.

🚀 Xepelin Performance & Career

Plataformas de capacitación: Convenios con las mejores plataformas, como Udemy y Google Cloud Skill Boost.

Kit de Bienvenida: todo lo que necesitas para comenzar tu viaje en Xepelin 😊

🤝 Xepelin Cares

Cobertura de salud: contamos con convenios de salud con proveedores de calidad o reembolsos según el país donde te encuentres.

Post Natal: te damos una semana extra de licencia post natal. ¡Nos interesa que estés con tu familia y seres queridos!

Matrimonio plus: Lleva tus planes al siguiente nivel, con una gift card y extendiendo tu permiso legal por matrimonio con dos días de regalo por Xepelin.

We’re fortunate to have an incredibly experienced leadership team, combined with world-class funding partners like A16Z, Matrix Partners, DST, Ribbit Capital, and a very healthy core business with a tremendous runway. In this role, you will participate in the design, development, and implementation of both backend services and the frontend experiences that power EarnIn’s new time & attendance product. Ensure the delivery of high-quality software features within established timelines.

title: VFX & Generative AI Artist
description:
About the job

Buscamos un/a Artista de VFX e IA Generativa para integrarse al equipo interno de CAPONETO. Será un perfil práctico, creativo y resolutivo, capaz de editar contenido audiovisual, realizar composiciones y efectos visuales de complejidad media, corregir color e incorporar herramientas de inteligencia artificial a los procesos de creación y postproducción.




No buscamos necesariamente un especialista senior en efectos visuales, sino una persona versátil, con buen ojo, criterio audiovisual y curiosidad tecnológica, que pueda ejecutar piezas con autonomía y encontrar soluciones eficientes para distintos tipos de proyectos.




Responsabilidades

•⁠ ⁠Editar y terminar piezas audiovisuales para contenido digital, branded content, campañas, presentaciones, cine y televisión.

•⁠ ⁠Realizar compositing, limpieza de imagen, reemplazo de pantallas, integración de fondos, rotoscopia, tracking, chroma key y otros efectos visuales.

•⁠ ⁠Crear, modificar y extender imágenes y videos mediante herramientas de IA generativa.

•⁠ ⁠Desarrollar pruebas visuales, concept videos, animatics, previos y propuestas de estilo.

•⁠ ⁠Integrar material generado con IA dentro de piezas filmadas o editadas de manera tradicional.

•⁠ ⁠Mantener la continuidad visual de personajes, espacios, iluminación, movimiento y estilo en las imágenes generadas.

•⁠ ⁠Realizar corrección de color y looks básicos para unificar y terminar las piezas.

•⁠ ⁠Adaptar contenidos a diferentes duraciones, formatos y relaciones de aspecto.

•⁠ ⁠Preparar versiones y archivos finales conforme a las especificaciones de cada proyecto.

•⁠ ⁠Trabajar en coordinación con productores, directores, editores, diseñadores y el área de postproducción.

•⁠ ⁠Recibir notas creativas y técnicas, interpretarlas y ejecutar los ajustes correspondientes.

•⁠ ⁠Investigar nuevas herramientas y proponer formas concretas de incorporarlas a los procesos de CAPONETO.

•⁠ ⁠Organizar correctamente proyectos, archivos, versiones y materiales de trabajo.




Conocimientos técnicos

•⁠ ⁠Manejo sólido de Adobe Premiere Pro.

•⁠ ⁠Conocimientos intermedios de After Effects para compositing, tracking, rotoscopia, keying y motion graphics.

•⁠ ⁠Manejo de DaVinci Resolve para corrección de color y terminación.

•⁠ ⁠Experiencia con herramientas de generación y edición de video e imagen mediante inteligencia artificial.

•⁠ ⁠Capacidad para trabajar con prompts, imágenes de referencia, image-to-video, video-to-video, inpainting, outpainting y extensión generativa.

•⁠ ⁠Conocimiento de formatos, códecs, resoluciones, frame rates y espacios de color.

•⁠ ⁠Nociones de flujos de proxies, conformado, exportación y entrega.

•⁠ ⁠Deseable: conocimientos de Photoshop, Illustrator, Blender, Cinema 4D, Nuke o herramientas similares.




Perfil

•⁠ ⁠Experiencia comprobable en edición, postproducción, VFX o creación de contenido audiovisual.

•⁠ ⁠Reel o portafolio que muestre trabajos de edición, compositing, color y/o contenido generado con IA.

•⁠ ⁠Buen ojo para la composición, el ritmo, la iluminación, el color y la integración de imágenes.

•⁠ ⁠Interés genuino por experimentar con nuevas herramientas y procesos.

•⁠ ⁠Capacidad para resolver problemas técnicos y visuales con los recursos disponibles.

•⁠ ⁠Persona organizada, autónoma, detallista y responsable.

•⁠ ⁠Capacidad para trabajar en varios proyectos y responder a tiempos de entrega ajustados.

•⁠ ⁠Buena disposición para recibir feedback y trabajar en equipo.

•⁠ ⁠Español fluido e inglés suficiente para utilizar herramientas, investigar procesos y comprender documentación técnica.




Buscamos a alguien que combine sensibilidad audiovisual con habilidad técnica; que disfrute editar, probar, componer y resolver. Alguien que entienda la IA como una herramienta más dentro del proceso creativo y que pueda convertir una idea o referencia en una pieza terminada, coherente y lista para entregar.

Industry expertise: Deep knowledge of the payments landscape and the fintech industry.
Specialized domain knowledge: A technical background in KYC, KYB, Risk, or Financial Crimes (FC).
Operational agility: Prior experience working within a queue.
description:
About the job

Who we are

About Stripe

At Stripe, our Mexico City office is a vibrant hub at the forefront of our mission to reshape the financial landscape for businesses worldwide. Our team prioritizes collaboration, innovation, and excellence. As a member of the Mexico City team, you'll be part of a mission-driven community dedicated to enhancing the global economy and increasing the GDP of the internet.

We strive for excellence by creating with craft and beauty, while having fun and celebrating our successes together. We cultivate a culture of collaboration, inclusivity, and support where every team member's voice matters. Our commitment shines through as we handle over a million support cases each year, empowering our users not just to solve problems but to achieve their goals.

About Bridge Operations And The Team

As Stripe's user base and global footprint grow dramatically, especially as crypto and stablecoins fundamentally change the way money is transferred, Stripe acquired Bridge to leverage its stablecoin infrastructure for global payments. Stablecoins facilitate faster, cheaper, and more efficient transactions than traditional methods, which creates unique compliance challenges.

The Bridge Operations strategy provides operational leverage and expands Stripe's portfolio of operational capabilities to support the scaled needs in this rapidly evolving space. This role will be part of the KYC and KYB Team within the Risk Ops organization in Bridge Operations that is accountable for performing KYC and KYB reviews during onboarding and periodic review.

What you'll do

We're looking for someone who is passionate about fighting risks and solving the puzzle of investigations, is naturally curious, and is comfortable operating in ambiguity and finding creative solutions. You will be responsible for spearheading the organization's KYC and KYB compliance efforts within the Mexican market.

The right candidate for this role will have experience in KYC and KYB compliance, preferably within the fintech or e-commerce space.

Responsibilities


Conduct thorough Know Your Customer (KYC) reviews during the onboarding of new users, ensuring the authenticity and accuracy of all customer documentation in compliance with Mexico's regulatory requirements.
Demonstrate a deep understanding of KYC, KYB, and anti-money laundering (AML) regulations specific to the Mexico financial services industry, and apply this knowledge to your daily analyses.
Exercise sound judgment to evaluate complex customer information, make informed decisions on the legitimacy of documentation provided, and determine the appropriate risk profile for each customer.
Handle high-complexity KYC and KYB-related assignments and tasks with a sense of urgency, while promptly resolving incoming requests from internal teams, financial partners, and other external parties.
Adhere closely to process documentation and draft clear, concise investigative summaries and analyses, including the preparation of regulatory reports for submission to the relevant authorities.
Actively participate in building a new team and operational culture focused on robust KYC and compliance practices within the organization.
Leverage your expertise in KYC, KYB, and AML to identify and escalate any suspicious customer activity or high-risk profiles to the compliance team for further investigation and action.
Collaborate cross-functionally with teams such as compliance and fraud to share information and insights that contribute to the overall risk management and mitigation efforts within the Mexican market.



Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


Bilingual in English: Excellent conversational, written, and reading skills.
Professional experience: 2+ years of experience in risk or any type of customer-facing roles within a fast-paced environment.
Resilience and adaptability: Proven ability to thrive in evolving environments, remain composed under pressure, and confidently navigate ambiguity.
Structured mindset: A logical, disciplined approach to problem-solving with a relentless focus on accuracy and attention to detail.
Proactive problem-solver: A self-starter capable of working independently to analyze complex data and make sound, defensible investigative decisions.
Process improvement: The ability to identify operational gaps and proactively implement solutions to enhance workflow efficiency.
Effective communication: Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal skills to clearly articulate findings and recommendations to internal teams and financial partners.
In-office presence: Full availability to work 100% on-site at our office in Reforma, CDMX.



Preferred Qualifications


Startup and tech background: Experience navigating the unique pace and scale of a technology-driven company.
Industry expertise: Deep knowledge of the payments landscape and the fintech industry.
Specialized domain knowledge: A technical background in KYC, KYB, Risk, or Financial Crimes (FC).
Operational agility: Prior experience working within a queue.



In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

title: Customer Operations Coordinator
skills: Receive and process purchase orders submitted through EDI, email, customer portals, or other approved channels, including manual orders for Mexico and selected Rest of LATAM customers.

Validate customer and ship-to information, store, SKU, quantity, unit of measure, pricing, purchase-order validity, requested delivery date, inventory availability, and customer-specific requirements before order creation.
Create and maintain SAP sales orders, including approved changes, cancellations, delivery-date updates, store changes, and other authorized adjustments, with a complete audit trail.
Monitor EDI order reception and promptly troubleshoot rejected, duplicated, incomplete, or missing transactions.
Coordinate order discrepancies with Commercial, the customer, Master Data, or the appropriate process owner before release.
Perform daily follow-up of open, blocked, incomplete, backordered, or aging orders from receipt through release, fulfillment, shipment, billing, and operational closure.
Prioritize orders based on customer SLA, channel cut-off, campaign or launch commitments, requested delivery date, commercial impact, and inventory availability.
Investigate order blocks related to pricing, credit, master data, inventory, delivery conditions, billing, customer documentation, or system interfaces.
Maintain clear visibility of the issue, owner, action, and expected resolution date, and escalate risks before they result in missed commitments, deductions, cancellations, or lost sales.
Provide accurate and timely order-status updates to customers and internal stakeholders when required.

Maintain working knowledge of the operational requirements for key department stores, wholesale accounts, and digital channels, including Liverpool, El Palacio de Hierro, Coppel, Sears, Amazon Mexico, and Mercado Libre.
Maintain a current customer-requirement matrix covering order reception, delivery appointments, labeling, documentation, billing, portals, returns, counter-receipts, and escalation contacts.
Coordinate purchase-order expiration dates, price changes, store changes, and customer-specific order requirements with the appropriate owners.
Support new-customer, new-store, and new-channel onboarding and confirm operational readiness before the first transaction is processed.
Manage the operational follow-up required for Liverpool invoicing, MIGO confirmation, and counter-receipt completion.
Investigate missing goods receipts and discrepancies involving purchase orders, stores, quantities, pricing, delivery documents, invoice status, or customer portal information.
Coordinate document recovery, invoice correction, and re-billing activities with Accounts Receivable, Commercial, Logistics, and the customer as applicable.
Maintain visibility of open items, aging, financial exposure, actions, and owners until final closure.
Monitor billing blocks, e-invoicing exceptions, rejected invoices, missing billing documents, and order-to-invoice discrepancies.
Troubleshoot operational billing issues and support approved invoice corrections or re-billing activities.
Provide supporting operational documentation to Accounts Receivable/Credit for invoice disputes, deductions, collection follow-up, and customer inquiries.
Track and escalate missing PODs when they prevent invoice acceptance, counter-receipt completion, collection, or claim resolution, coordinating recovery with Logistics.
Support order-to-cash execution without assuming ownership of credit approval, collections strategy, cash application, or final credit-note approval.
Create and manage consignment orders, consignment returns, billing follow-up, and related inventory or customer discrepancies.
Create and follow up on return authorizations and RMAs after validating customer, invoice, product, quantity, reason, and approval information.
Coordinate physical return collection with Logistics and receipt, inspection, disposition, and inventory processing with Warehouse Operations and the 3PL.
Track returns from authorization through warehouse receipt, quality inspection, credit-note initiation, and closure, including aging, missing, damaged, or unauthorized returns.
Coordinate RMA closure and reporting with Accounts Receivable, Finance, Warehouse Operations, and the customer.
Validate customer, ship-to, store, delivery, billing, EDI, and portal setup from an operational perspective before transactions begin.
Identify customer-master or product-master issues that prevent correct order processing and submit changes through the approved MDM process.
Confirm that approved customer, store, pricing, or product changes have been correctly implemented before order release.
Maintain segregation between requesting, approving, and executing master-data or sensitive transaction changes.
Monitor and troubleshoot SAP sales orders, EDI transactions, inventory-availability messages, SAP/WMS order-status interfaces, e-invoicing, customer portals, and pricing conditions.
Determine whether an issue originates from customer information, master data, pricing, SAP configuration, EDI mapping, WMS/3PL execution, inventory, or user error.
Document system issues with transaction numbers, evidence, expected results, and business impact, and coordinate resolution with IT/SAP, Master Data, Global Customer Operations, or the 3PL.
Own issue follow-up through correction, business validation, and final closure rather than only forwarding the initial request.
Support inventory-interface troubleshooting and controlled manual contingencies only when the required approvals, duplicate-order controls, reconciliation, and audit trail are in place.

Prepare and maintain daily, weekly, and monthly reporting for order volume, manual versus EDI orders, EDI failures, open and blocked orders, order aging, billing exceptions, Liverpool MIGO and counter-receipt status, missing PODs, returns/RMA, and system issues.
Quantify the sales, customer-service, billing, collection, or inventory impact of material exceptions and communicate the required action clearly.
Maintain issue trackers and action logs with owners, due dates, escalation triggers, and closure evidence.
Identify recurring errors, bottlenecks, and manual activities and recommend process, system, automation, or control improvements.
Support operational reviews with Support operational reviews with Customer Operations, Commercial, Finance, IT/SAP, Logistics, Warehouse Operations, and external partners
Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain, International Business, Commerce, Industrial Engineering, Finance, or a related discipline preferred.
2-4 years of experience in Customer Operations, Order Management, Customer Service, Sales Operations, Supply Chain, or an order-to-cash environment.
Experience processing B2B customer orders and managing order, billing, or return exceptions.
Working knowledge of SAP, preferably SAP SD and order-to-cash processes, together with EDI, customer portals, e-invoicing, or integrated order-management environments.
Experience supporting department stores, wholesale customers, e-commerce, or marketplace channels strongly preferred.
Knowledge of Mexican retail billing, counter-receipt, POD, return, and customer-documentation requirements; Liverpool process experience is highly desirable.
Intermediate to advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including data validation, pivot tables, lookups, and operational reporting.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, follow-up, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Strong written and verbal communication skills in Spanish and working proficiency in English for collaboration with regional and global stakeholders.
Experience in a multi-brand, high-value product, fashion, watch, jewelry, luxury, or consumer-goods environment preferred.

We offer the watch industry a compelling strategic vision and track record of sustained growth and we offer our employees unparalleled opportunities for career advancement. We invite you to come share in our success. Our people are the cornerstone of business – we invite you to grow your career with us.

The Customer Operations Coordinator is responsible for the accurate and timely execution of customer orders from receipt through billing and operational closure across Mexico and selected LATAM markets. The role receives and validates manual and EDI purchase orders, creates and maintains SAP sales orders, manages exceptions, supports returns and billing, and protects customer commitments.

The position serves as the operational link between customers, Commercial, Global Customer Operations, Accounts Receivable/Credit, Master Data, IT/SAP, Logistics, Warehouse Operations, and the 3PL partner.

Key Responsibilities

Purchase Order Receipt, Validation and SAP Order Entry


Receive and process purchase orders submitted through EDI, email, customer portals, or other approved channels, including manual orders for Mexico and selected Rest of LATAM customers.
Validate customer and ship-to information, store, SKU, quantity, unit of measure, pricing, purchase-order validity, requested delivery date, inventory availability, and customer-specific requirements before order creation.
Create and maintain SAP sales orders, including approved changes, cancellations, delivery-date updates, store changes, and other authorized adjustments, with a complete audit trail.
Monitor EDI order reception and promptly troubleshoot rejected, duplicated, incomplete, or missing transactions.
Coordinate order discrepancies with Commercial, the customer, Master Data, or the appropriate process owner before release.


Open-Order Management and Customer Commitments


Perform daily follow-up of open, blocked, incomplete, backordered, or aging orders from receipt through release, fulfillment, shipment, billing, and operational closure.
Prioritize orders based on customer SLA, channel cut-off, campaign or launch commitments, requested delivery date, commercial impact, and inventory availability.
Investigate order blocks related to pricing, credit, master data, inventory, delivery conditions, billing, customer documentation, or system interfaces.
Maintain clear visibility of the issue, owner, action, and expected resolution date, and escalate risks before they result in missed commitments, deductions, cancellations, or lost sales.
Provide accurate and timely order-status updates to customers and internal stakeholders when required.


Customer And Channel Requirements


Maintain working knowledge of the operational requirements for key department stores, wholesale accounts, and digital channels, including Liverpool, El Palacio de Hierro, Coppel, Sears, Amazon Mexico, and Mercado Libre.
Maintain a current customer-requirement matrix covering order reception, delivery appointments, labeling, documentation, billing, portals, returns, counter-receipts, and escalation contacts.
Coordinate purchase-order expiration dates, price changes, store changes, and customer-specific order requirements with the appropriate owners.
Support new-customer, new-store, and new-channel onboarding and confirm operational readiness before the first transaction is processed.


Liverpool Billing, MIGO and Counter-Receipt Support


Manage the operational follow-up required for Liverpool invoicing, MIGO confirmation, and counter-receipt completion.
Investigate missing goods receipts and discrepancies involving purchase orders, stores, quantities, pricing, delivery documents, invoice status, or customer portal information.
Coordinate document recovery, invoice correction, and re-billing activities with Accounts Receivable, Commercial, Logistics, and the customer as applicable.
Maintain visibility of open items, aging, financial exposure, actions, and owners until final closure.


Billing and Order-to-Cash Operational Support


Monitor billing blocks, e-invoicing exceptions, rejected invoices, missing billing documents, and order-to-invoice discrepancies.
Troubleshoot operational billing issues and support approved invoice corrections or re-billing activities.
Provide supporting operational documentation to Accounts Receivable/Credit for invoice disputes, deductions, collection follow-up, and customer inquiries.
Track and escalate missing PODs when they prevent invoice acceptance, counter-receipt completion, collection, or claim resolution, coordinating recovery with Logistics.
Support order-to-cash execution without assuming ownership of credit approval, collections strategy, cash application, or final credit-note approval.


Consignment Orders, Returns and RMA Management


Create and manage consignment orders, consignment returns, billing follow-up, and related inventory or customer discrepancies.
Create and follow up on return authorizations and RMAs after validating customer, invoice, product, quantity, reason, and approval information.
Coordinate physical return collection with Logistics and receipt, inspection, disposition, and inventory processing with Warehouse Operations and the 3PL.
Track returns from authorization through warehouse receipt, quality inspection, credit-note initiation, and closure, including aging, missing, damaged, or unauthorized returns.
Coordinate RMA closure and reporting with Accounts Receivable, Finance, Warehouse Operations, and the customer.


Customer and Master Data Operational Validation


Validate customer, ship-to, store, delivery, billing, EDI, and portal setup from an operational perspective before transactions begin.
Identify customer-master or product-master issues that prevent correct order processing and submit changes through the approved MDM process.
Confirm that approved customer, store, pricing, or product changes have been correctly implemented before order release.
Maintain segregation between requesting, approving, and executing master-data or sensitive transaction changes.


SAP, EDI and Interface Troubleshooting


Monitor and troubleshoot SAP sales orders, EDI transactions, inventory-availability messages, SAP/WMS order-status interfaces, e-invoicing, customer portals, and pricing conditions.
Determine whether an issue originates from customer information, master data, pricing, SAP configuration, EDI mapping, WMS/3PL execution, inventory, or user error.
Document system issues with transaction numbers, evidence, expected results, and business impact, and coordinate resolution with IT/SAP, Master Data, Global Customer Operations, or the 3PL.
Own issue follow-up through correction, business validation, and final closure rather than only forwarding the initial request.
Support inventory-interface troubleshooting and controlled manual contingencies only when the required approvals, duplicate-order controls, reconciliation, and audit trail are in place.


Reporting, KPI Monitoring and Continuous Improvement


Prepare and maintain daily, weekly, and monthly reporting for order volume, manual versus EDI orders, EDI failures, open and blocked orders, order aging, billing exceptions, Liverpool MIGO and counter-receipt status, missing PODs, returns/RMA, and system issues.
Quantify the sales, customer-service, billing, collection, or inventory impact of material exceptions and communicate the required action clearly.
Maintain issue trackers and action logs with owners, due dates, escalation triggers, and closure evidence.
Identify recurring errors, bottlenecks, and manual activities and recommend process, system, automation, or control improvements.
Support operational reviews with Support operational reviews with Customer Operations, Commercial, Finance, IT/SAP, Logistics, Warehouse Operations, and external partners


Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain, International Business, Commerce, Industrial Engineering, Finance, or a related discipline preferred.
2-4 years of experience in Customer Operations, Order Management, Customer Service, Sales Operations, Supply Chain, or an order-to-cash environment.
Experience processing B2B customer orders and managing order, billing, or return exceptions.
Working knowledge of SAP, preferably SAP SD and order-to-cash processes, together with EDI, customer portals, e-invoicing, or integrated order-management environments.
Experience supporting department stores, wholesale customers, e-commerce, or marketplace channels strongly preferred.
Knowledge of Mexican retail billing, counter-receipt, POD, return, and customer-documentation requirements; Liverpool process experience is highly desirable.
Intermediate to advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including data validation, pivot tables, lookups, and operational reporting.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, follow-up, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Strong written and verbal communication skills in Spanish and working proficiency in English for collaboration with regional and global stakeholders.
Experience in a multi-brand, high-value product, fashion, watch, jewelry, luxury, or consumer-goods environment preferred.


DIRECT APPLICANTS ONLY - NO AGENCIES

About the job

🚀 Buscamos un/a Customer Support Specialist L1 en México para sumarse a AgendaPro.




AgendaPro es la plataforma líder en LATAM para gestionar agenda, pagos y crecimiento en negocios de belleza, salud y bienestar, con más de 12 años creciendo y respaldo de Y Combinator y una Serie B de US$35M.




Estamos en plena transformación: pasamos de un SaaS horizontal a un modelo de verticales con agentes de IA, y estamos armando los equipos que van a llevar estas nuevas líneas de negocio al mercado. Es una etapa temprana donde todavía hay muchísimo por construir, probar y escalar y queremos que seas parte desde el principio.




Buscamos gente con ganas de aprender, actitud resolutiva y vocación de servicio, que entienda que detrás de cada conversación hay un emprendedor confiando en nosotros.




📍 Modalidad híbrida – con esquema de turnos: días presenciales con entrada a las 09:00 y fines de semana remoto.




Tu desafío: Ser la primera línea de soporte vía chat (Intercom) y resolver los problemas de nuestros clientes con rapidez, claridad y empatía. Cada conversación bien resuelta es un cliente que se queda.




🚀 Qué harás / Responsabilidades:

• Atención en Intercom (tu cancha principal): gestionar tu bandeja de conversaciones, tomar casos y responder en tiempo real.

• Comunicarte con clientes por chat (canal principal) y, ocasionalmente, por mail, teléfono o videollamada.

• Ser el reflejo de la marca en cada mensaje: claro, empático y paciente, sobre todo con clientes poco tecnologizados.

• Resolver consultas de usabilidad guiando al cliente paso a paso dentro de AgendaPro.

• Crear y documentar tickets internos con todo el detalle cuando corresponda.

• Trabajar junto a Tecnología y Producto para que los errores se resuelvan rápido, sin perder nunca el seguimiento con el cliente.

• Cumplir las métricas del área: CSAT, tiempo de primera respuesta (FRT), tiempo de resolución y productividad diaria.

• Participar en capacitaciones, QA y mejora continua de flujos y respuestas.




Requisitos:

• Pasión real por el servicio al cliente: no descansas hasta dejar al usuario con su problema resuelto.

• Excelente comunicación escrita en español: sabes explicar lo complejo de forma simple.

• Habilidad tecnológica básica: navegadores, correo, hojas de cálculo y varias pestañas/herramientas abiertas a la vez sin marearte.

• Comodidad para revisar configuraciones y guiar al cliente en las suyas.

• Proactividad, paciencia, empatía y aguante para manejar varias conversaciones a la vez.

• Disponibilidad para el esquema de turnos (presencial con entrada a las 09:00 y remoto los fines de semana).




Suma puntos (no excluyente):

• Experiencia en atención al cliente, ventas o customer success en empresas de tecnología / SaaS.

• Conocimiento de herramientas tipo Intercom, Zendesk o CRMs.

• Nociones de web, APIs, redes o tecnología en general.

• Inglés intermedio.
