description:
About the job

To apply, you will only have to fill a short form on our website that will take you less than 5 minutes.




Job Title: Lifecycle Marketer




About the Company:

Our client is a US fintech company that provides individuals outside the United States with a US dollar account, international money transfer capabilities, and a card for direct USD spending, all within a single app. Their primary markets are in Latin America, serving freelancers, digital nomads, savers seeking inflation protection, and crypto users who want to manage stablecoins within their banking app. The company is currently in a hypergrowth phase and is seeking individuals eager to contribute to building and innovation.




Job Description:

Our client is seeking a Lifecycle Marketer to manage all user communications throughout their entire journey, from initial sign-up to activation, ongoing engagement, reactivation, and retention. This role requires a hands-on approach, where the individual will not only strategize but also execute by designing flows, writing copy, implementing campaigns in various tools, and continuously measuring and optimizing performance. A data-first mindset is crucial, with a focus on defining, measuring, and iterating on every campaign and message using key metrics. The ideal candidate will be adept at analyzing user funnels, identifying drop-off points, and proactively implementing solutions.

The role is structured around three core pillars: Lifecycle Strategy & Communications, CRM & Omnichannel Marketing, and Testing, Optimization & Analytics. This includes owning lifecycle programs for all user segments, developing customer journey strategies, mapping user journeys, identifying optimization opportunities through segmentation and personalization, and driving cross-sell initiatives. The role also involves designing and optimizing programs across various channels like email, SMS, push notifications, WhatsApp, and in-app messaging, while ensuring channel health and prioritizing trigger- and behavior-based automation. A significant part of the role includes measuring performance using tools like Mixpanel, running A/B tests, reporting on lifecycle impact, leveraging AI for content generation and data analysis, and collaborating with Product and Design teams.




Responsibilities of the role:

• Own the lifecycle programs across all user segments.

• Develop and execute customer journey strategies for acquisition, engagement, retention, and reactivation.

• Map user journeys, identify key moments and drop-off points, and design communication to advance users.

• Identify opportunities to improve lifecycle performance through segmentation, automation, personalization, and testing.

• Drive cross-sell across USD account, card, and stablecoin wallet features.

• Design and optimize lifecycle programs across email, SMS, push, WhatsApp, and in-app channels.

• Build scalable segmentation, personalization, and automation strategies.

• Build, launch, and optimize automated lifecycle campaigns end-to-end.

• Prioritize trigger- and behavior-based automation over blast campaigns.

• Protect channel health, including email deliverability, opt-ins, message frequency, and fatigue.

• Measure performance in Mixpanel, define events, build funnels, analyze cohorts, churn, and LTV.

• Run experiments and A/B tests on copy, timing, channel, and segment.

• Report on lifecycle impact on activation, retention, and engagement with clear metrics.

• Utilize AI tools for content generation, task automation, and data analysis.

• Partner with Product and Design to align in-app communication with roadmap launches.




Required Experience and Qualifications:

• Demonstrated ownership mentality, taking problems to completion.

• Blend of strategic thinking and operational execution capabilities.

• Strong analytical skills and data-driven decision-making abilities, comfortable analyzing funnels, cohorts, churn, and LTV, with the ability to query data independently.

• Ability to write effective copy that drives conversions, understanding that lifecycle communication serves both marketing and product functions.

• Daily experience working with AI and automation tools.

• High drive and initiative, with a focus on building and innovation.

• Fluent communication in both Spanish and English.




Preferred Skills:

• Previous experience in fintech, crypto, or Web3.

• Based in Argentina or LATAM.

• Experience in a high-growth startup environment.




Personality:

• Takes ownership and sees tasks through to completion.

• Combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution.

• Data-first approach to decision-making.

• Creative and driven to build.




Software & Tools:

• Analytics: Mixpanel

• Messaging & CRM: OneSignal, WhatsApp, email

• Product: in-app stories / in-app messaging, email, SMS

• Design: Figma

• AI: Claude and other AI tools

• Automation: end-to-end lifecycle flows and automations




Schedule:

Full-time




Salary and Benefits:

• Payment in USD or Local Currency according to candidate's preference.

• Full-time remote opportunity.

title: Coordinador/a de Postprodución
description:
About the job

Buscamos un/a Coordinador/a de Postproducción para supervisar y dar seguimiento integral a los procesos de postproducción de proyectos audiovisuales de CAPONETO CONTENT. 




El perfil ideal combina conocimientos técnicos con capacidad de organización, comunicación y resolución de problemas. Será el vínculo entre productores, editores, coloristas, artistas de VFX, diseñadores, estudios de sonido y proveedores externos, asegurando que cada proyecto avance en tiempo, presupuesto y conforme a sus especificaciones técnicas y creativas.




RESPONSABILIDADES:

•⁠ ⁠Diseñar, organizar y dar seguimiento a los flujos de trabajo de postproducción, desde la recepción y respaldo del material hasta la entrega final.

•⁠ ⁠Elaborar calendarios, rutas críticas y planes de entregas para proyectos simultáneos.

•⁠ ⁠Supervisar procesos de ingesta, respaldo, organización, sincronización, generación de proxies, edición offline, conformado, color, VFX, mezcla y masterización.

•⁠ ⁠Preparar y revisar masters, versiones, subtítulos, materiales gráficos y entregables para plataformas, networks, festivales, salas y redes sociales.

•⁠ ⁠Realizar controles de calidad técnicos y de contenido antes de cada entrega.

•⁠ ⁠Llevar un registro claro de versiones, cambios, aprobaciones y pendientes.

•⁠ ⁠Administrar materiales en servidores, discos, plataformas de revisión y sistemas de almacenamiento en la nube.

•⁠ ⁠Detectar riesgos técnicos, retrasos o cuellos de botella y proponer soluciones de manera anticipada.




CONOCIMIENTOS TÉCNICOS

•⁠ ⁠Dominio de formatos, códecs, contenedores, resoluciones y estándares de entrega audiovisual.

•⁠ ⁠Conocimiento práctico de flujos de edición offline y online, proxies, relink, conformado y masterización.

•⁠ ⁠Experiencia con procesos de corrección de color, VFX, motion graphics, mezcla de sonido y subtitulaje.

•⁠ ⁠Manejo de Adobe Premiere Pro y conocimiento de DaVinci Resolve y After Effects.

•⁠ ⁠Familiaridad con plataformas de revisión y colaboración como Frame.io o similares.

•⁠ ⁠Conocimiento de almacenamiento, respaldos, transferencia de archivos y organización de media.

•⁠ ⁠Capacidad para interpretar y aplicar especificaciones técnicas de plataformas, televisoras y distribuidores.

•⁠ ⁠Deseable: conocimiento de flujos de trabajo para cine, HDR, DCP, IMF y materiales de distribución internacional.




PERFIL

•⁠ ⁠Experiencia comprobable coordinando postproducción audiovisual.

•⁠ ⁠Español e inglés profesional, tanto oral como escrito.

•⁠ ⁠Extremadamente organizado/a y cuidadoso/a con los detalles.

•⁠ ⁠Perfil técnico, práctico y orientado a soluciones.

•⁠ ⁠Facilidad para manejar varios proyectos, proveedores y fechas de entrega simultáneamente.

•⁠ ⁠Excelentes habilidades interpersonales y de comunicación.

•⁠ ⁠Capacidad para traducir necesidades creativas en procesos y requerimientos técnicos claros.

•⁠ ⁠Buen criterio para priorizar y trabajar bajo presión.

•⁠ ⁠Actitud colaborativa, flexible y responsable.

•⁠ ⁠Interés por mantenerse actualizado/a en herramientas, tecnologías y estándares de la industria.




Buscamos a alguien que no solo dé seguimiento a los procesos de postproducción, sino que comprenda técnicamente cada etapa del proceso, detecte riesgos antes de que se conviertan en problemas y ayude a construir una operación de postproducción cada vez más eficiente, ordenada y confiable.

description:
About the job

About Rippling

Rippling is the first way for businesses to manage all of their HR & IT—payroll, benefits, computers, apps, and more—in one unified workforce platform.

By connecting every business system to one source of truth for employee data, businesses can automate all of the manual work they normally need to do to make employee changes. Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can just click a button and set up a new employees’ payroll, health insurance, work computer, and third-party apps—like Slack, Zoom, and Office 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

About The Role

At Rippling, Sales Development is the driving force behind two main functions: pipeline creation and career development. We execute with a high level of urgency to partner with marketing and our sales partners to drive demand and create new business opportunities. Simultaneously we double down on the development of our people; creating career paths that allow reps to move through the SDR org and into more strategic roles that align with their future career aspirations.

As an SDR Manager, you’re focused on coaching and developing your regional reps. Building pipeline, managing processes, and focusing on per rep production is vital.

What You Will Do


Top of funnel leader that can execute on business needs. 
Able to leverage data to ensure that SLA’s and KPI’s are hit daily. 
Working side by side with your reps and coaching them how to handle objections and pitch Rippling in order to book demos with prospects. 
Motivates your reps to learn and grow daily preparing them for their next sales role. 
Strong leader that owns a specific function and is able to translate the needs of the business throughout their org. 
Heavily involved in hiring top talent for the SDR organization
Displaying cross functional empathy and able to deliver high level and tactical feedback across the orgs. 
Consistently drive the business to achieve and exceed revenue targets. 


What You Will Need


2+ years in an SDR Organization and 1+ years in SDR Leadership. 
Proficiency in SDR Tech Stack: Outreach, Salesloft, Mixmax, Salesforce, LI Sales Navigator, Zoominfo, Lusha, LeadIQ, SalesIntel, Gong/Chorus, Guru/Highspot.

Experience building an Outbound program or executing an outbound strategy that involves multichannel approaches tracked heavily by input/output metrics. 
Excellent abilities to manage at the ground level while also able to zoom out and define and execute on broader business initiatives. 
A deep understanding of scaling orgs in fast-paced environments. 
Experience in change management.
